action.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.account_id = '4100' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(g.credit - g.debit), 0) AS services_revenue_share_pct FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06'
